text: McDonald's plans up to $8.5B in franchisee support through 2036 for restaurant, equipment, technology and operating upgrades. Restaurant > NEXT includes ArchIQ, while Make It Golden standardizes employee training across food quality and service.

meta.note: Franchisee capital requirements are not fully specified.

text: Toms Capital, now a top-five Devon shareholder, urged the company to review strategic alternatives including a full sale. Devon's post-Coterra portfolio spans the Delaware, Marcellus, Eagle Ford and Powder River basins, while Kimmeridge separately advocates portfolio streamlining.

meta.note: No sale process is disclosed; shareholder proposals remain separate from company action.

text: Pezeshkian presented Iran's military posture as defensive and rejected U.S. claims at the UN while affirming readiness for negotiations without coercion. U.S.-Iranian diplomatic contacts remain active alongside the continuing armed conflict.

meta.note: Competing claims about military conduct remain unresolved; diplomatic contact and armed conflict coexist.

text: The 10-year Treasury yield rose over 13 bps to 5.104%, its highest since July 2007 and largest daily increase since April 2025. The 2-year reached 4.889% and the 30-year 5.398%, while a five-year Treasury auction cleared at 5.033%.

meta.note: Multiple contemporaneous inputs prevent attribution of the yield move to a single condition.

text: OpenAI and Anthropic leaders urged international AI coordination before the UN Security Council, including shared testing and risk-management structures. The U.S. administration separately rejects international control structures that constrain AI development.

meta.note: Industry coordination proposals and the U.S. federal position remain structurally distinct.
